fullPassage: Human processes differ from rational processes in their outcome. A process is rational if it always does the right thing based on the current information, given an ideal performance measure. In short, rational processes go by the book and assume that the book is actually correct. Human processes involve instinct, intuition, and other variables that don’t necessarily reflect the book and may not even consider the existing data. As an example, the rational way to drive a car is to always follow the laws. Likewise, pedestrian crossing signs vary depending on the country with differing appearances of a person crossing the street. However, traffic isn’t rational; if you follow the laws precisely, you end up stuck somewhere because other drivers aren’t following the laws precisely. To be successful, a self-driving car must therefore act humanly, rather than rationally.

questions.passage: Human processes differ from rational processes in their outcome. A process is rational if it always does the right thing based on the current information, given an ideal performance measure. In short, rational processes go by the book and assume that the book is actually correct. Human processes involve instinct, intuition, and other variables that don’t necessarily reflect the book and may not even consider the existing data. As an example, the rational way to drive a car is to always follow the laws. Likewise, pedestrian crossing signs vary depending on the country with differing appearances of a person crossing the street. However, traffic isn’t rational; if you follow the laws precisely, you end up stuck somewhere because other drivers aren’t following the laws precisely. To be successful, a self-driving car must therefore __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이성적으로가 아닌 인간적으로 행동해야 한다 (자율주행차의 결론)
det.analysis:
❌ ① always follow laws: 법을 항상 따르면 갇힌다고 했으므로 부적절
❌ ② involve instinct: 인간 과정의 특성이지 자율주행차의 해결책이 아님
❌ ③ go by the book: 이성적 과정이지 자율주행차 해결책이 아님
✅ ④ act humanly, rather than rationally: 원문 일치. 교통이 이성적이지 않으므로 인간적으로 행동 ←정답
